# The Dot Creative Agency

> Web design and connected business systems for growing Ontario businesses. We build accessible, conversion-focused websites, connect them to the CRM, accounting, scheduling and intake tools you already run, automate the busywork, and help you get recommended by AI search (GEO).

The Dot Creative is a boutique agency based in Ontario, Canada. We combine web design and development with business systems integration, workflow automation, AODA accessibility, and AI-visibility (Generative Engine Optimization).

## Services

- [Web Design + Business Systems](https://www.thedotcreative.co/services/web-design-business-systems): Accessible, conversion-focused websites connected to your CRM, accounting, scheduling and intake tools. One connected system.
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.thedotcreative.co/services/workflow-automation): Automate the manual client and admin workflows that eat your week. Typically saves 10 to 20 hours a month.
- [AODA Web Accessibility](https://www.thedotcreative.co/services/aoda-web-accessibility): AODA / WCAG accessible design built in from the start, plus practical audits for existing Ontario sites.
- [Managed Website Growth](https://www.thedotcreative.co/services/managed-website-growth): Ongoing performance, conversion, SEO, AI-visibility and accessibility upkeep after launch.
- [AI-Visibility (GEO) Audit](https://www.thedotcreative.co/services/ai-visibility-audit): Find out whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity recommend your business, and fix what keeps AI from naming you.

## Tools

- [Free AI-Visibility Check](https://www.thedotcreative.co/tools/ai-visibility): See whether AI recommends your business by name and by need, in about two minutes.

## Pricing

- Professional Foundation (website): 2,500 to 4,500 CAD
- Connected Business System (site plus integration plus automation): 5,500 to 7,500 CAD
- Design and Consulting (audits, brand, add-ons): from 350 CAD

## Area served

Ontario, Canada, including the Greater Toronto Area.

## Notes

The Dot Creative does not guarantee placement in AI answers; AI results are probabilistic and change over time. Accessibility (AODA) obligations depend on an organization's size and sector and should be confirmed against current Ontario requirements.
